findings.title: TeamUpdraft security incident: What customers need to know - TeamUpdraft
findings.summary_md: TeamUpdraft published a security notice confirming unauthorized access to teamupdraft.com over the weekend of 17-18 October 2026. The vendor stated it believes the attacker accessed the customer database containing UpdraftCentral connection keys and customer account details, and it recommended rotating storage credentials and reauthorizing connections.

findings.title: Critical security problem in UpdraftCentral: an attacker holding the service's keys planted a backdoor on our websites - Nethemba
findings.summary_md: Nethemba reported that on the night of 19 October 2026 an attacker abused UpdraftCentral remote-management keys taken from TeamUpdraft's customer database to install a malicious backdoor plugin (Wp Tune / Link Frame 3Fb) on connected WordPress sites. The article notes notifications to Wordfence and Patchstack on 19 October 2026.

findings.title: Stolen UpdraftCentral Keys Are Backdooring WordPress Sites - Patchstack
findings.summary_md: Patchstack documented the active exploitation campaign using stolen UpdraftCentral keys, noting an 18-hour backdoor installation window spanning 18-19 October 2026. The article confirms the attacker sent plugin.upload_plugin commands through the UpdraftCentral channel rather than vendor infrastructure.
